checks.integrity: The fixed dock, full-height fader geometry, A/B divider, performance contact sources, R34/R35/R37 analysis/preparation and R39 navigation state match the integration baseline. ReplicaView changes are confined to LoadSlider.
checks.review: Self-review under the project rule against parallel agents.
checks.harnessScope: The browser harness compiles production column, contact and loader sources. It removes the TDJCore import from a temporary copy and uses the exact DeckID enum declaration from Models.swift. The signed iPad build checks the full module integration.

behaviour: Sources and Details retain their exclusive drawer presentation over the full-width Songs, Suggestions and Prep lists. The selected-song loading shelf is unchanged apart from retained loader coordinates and selection identity.
Visible drawers have dedicated 44-point grab lanes. Existing Sources and Details buttons reopen them at their remembered widths.
Source widths for song/playlist navigation and Details widths are remembered per orientation for the session. Navigation/query state is separate from sizing.
Partial drawer content blocks new touches while held loader contacts retain their original global frame. Explicit close, selected-song replacement and interruption cancel the loader.
Optional detail artwork yields at narrow widths while its loader keeps full size. No resize grab overlays a list row or loader.
R39 full-library suggestions, fixed reference, separate queries, queue and selected-song loading remain on their existing paths.
limits: Physical gesture delivery, scrolling, both loader ends, drawer reopening, accessibility focus and clean audio need Erik acceptance.
Sizes last for the session. Very small windows cannot fit the optional drawers.
This does not establish original TDJ1 gesture or sound equivalence.

preIntegrationCandidate.reason: Full-width R39 browser work arrived before compilation. Final integration retains it and adds drawer sizing.
